registration_statements: This was a double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized clinical trial conducted on in-patients with schizophrenia at Roozbeh Hospital (Tehran University of Medical Sciences (TUMS), Tehran, Iran) and Imam Ali Hospital (Alborz University of Medical Sciences, Karaj, Iran) from November 2019 to July 2020. Prior to the study, written informed consent was obtained from patients and their legal guardian to enter the study. They were informed that at any time during the study and without the need to provide any reason and without any disruption in receiving routine services related to their disease, they could withdraw from the study. Patients were randomly divided into two parallel spironolactone and placebo groups and were assessed after the first week and then at weeks two, four and eight. The trial was conducted in agreement with the ethical principles mandated in the Declaration of Helsinki and its later amendments ( 13 ). Also, the ethics committee and institutional review board of TUMS approved the protocol for this study (IR.TUMS.VCR.REC.1398.540). This study is registered at the Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials (IRCT20090117001556N120).
